title: honest baseline bars zero or truncation
rule: Honest baseline: bars start at zero or show truncation. Meaningful scales, consistent time intervals, readable labels. Don’t rotate labels to hide a truncated axis.
pass_when: Bars start at zero, or truncation is shown; scales/intervals are consistent; labels are not rotated to hide a truncated axis.
fail_when: Truncated bar axis with no truncation mark; labels rotated to hide it.
overview: Bars start at zero or show truncation; keep scales honest and consistent.
apply_when: Bar charts where baseline and scale honesty matter.
not_when: Truncated bar axes without a mark, or labels rotated to hide truncation.
agent_hint: Start bars at zero or mark truncation; never rotate labels to hide a truncated axis.
description: Honest baseline: bars start at zero or show truncation. Use meaningful scales, consistent time intervals, and readable labels. Don’t rotate labels to hide a truncated axis. Pass when bars start at zero or truncation is shown, scales and intervals are consistent, and labels are not rotated to hide truncation. Fail when a truncated bar axis has no truncation mark or labels are rotated to hide it.
